key_themes: Q2 2026 quarter-end rally — best quarter for S&P 500 and Nasdaq since 2020
Defense/drone sector surge led by AeroVironment massive earnings beat (+133% revenue YoY)
Biotech catalyst: Abivax Phase 3 ABTECT trial success for ulcerative colitis drug obefazimod
AI/data center capex cycle driving upgrades in water tech and semiconductor connectivity names
Heavy analyst action day — notable double-upgrade for Block, downgrades for Fortinet and Logitech

stocks.reason: Surged ~18-20% after reporting Q4 FY2026 earnings beat: revenue +133% YoY to $642M (vs. $559M est.), EPS $1.84 vs. $1.46 est. Record full-year revenue of $1.97B on rising military drone demand.
Jumped ~40% after Phase 3 ABTECT trial of obefazimod in ulcerative colitis hit FDA primary endpoint and all key secondary endpoints at Week 44 (50-51% clinical remission vs. 10.4% on placebo, N=580).
Tumbled ~22% after missing Q2 earnings and revenue estimates and issuing weak Q3 and full-year 2026 guidance. Technology services demand slowdown.
Q4 FY2026 earnings released today: revenue $11.0B (down 1% reported, -4% currency-neutral). NIKE Direct revenue fell 7% YoY; wholesale up 4%. Full-year revenue $46.4B, flat YoY.
Fell ~8.4% after a regulatory roadblock slammed the proposed Norfolk Southern / Union Pacific merger, raising doubts about deal completion timeline.
Dropped ~4.2% after agreeing to acquire a stake in three fully leased data centers from Blackstone for $7.8 billion, raising leverage concerns.
Jumped ~7% after Barclays upgraded to Overweight, citing Watts as "best positioned" in water/waste tech to benefit from the data center capital expenditure cycle.
Received a rare double upgrade from Piper Sandler, lifted to Overweight from Underweight with target raised to $100 from $58, citing improved fintech monetization outlook.
Upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Daiwa, with price target raised to $255 from $240, reflecting confidence in the industrial conglomerate's restructuring and aerospace segment.
Upgraded to Buy from Hold at Deutsche Bank with $32 target (trimmed from $34), as analysts see improving broadband subscriber trajectory and SpinCo separation catalyst.
Downgraded to Reduce from Hold at HSBC with a $102 price target, flagging valuation concerns and competitive pressure in the firewall/network security segment.
Downgraded to Underperform from Neutral at BofA, target cut to $86 from $108. BofA expects demand to "worsen materially" over the next 12-18 months as PC/peripheral cycle weakens.
Slipped ~0.6% after Reuters reported a U.S. House committee launched a probe into whether Merck (and AbbVie) participated in clinical trials in China that aided Chinese military capabilities.
Jumped ~7% (to ~$493 from ~$456) amid continued AI data center connectivity demand; stock is up significantly on the quarter as semiconductor/AI names led Q2 2026 rally.
Fell ~3%, giving back some of Monday's sharp gains as Bitcoin pulled back; the crypto proxy stock remains highly volatile around quarter-end rebalancing flows.
